name: Investigate the Scourge of Darnassus
summary: Investigate the Scourge of Darnassus is an emergency mission issued by Lieutenant Beitha on behalf of the Argent Dawn. With a necropolis looming over the Scourge encampment, Alliance defenders are tasked with destroying encroaching undead and deciphering the dark runic circles appearing outside the city gates.

sections.title: A Plague on the World Tree
sections.body: The Scourge invasion has reached the sheltered boughs of Teldrassil. Floating necropolises appear in the sky, vomiting forth ghouls, skeletons, and necromantic horrors right outside Darnassus. Lieutenant Beitha of the Argent Dawn has stepped forward to coordinate the capital's defense, enlisting willing volunteers to blunt the vanguard and gather intelligence before the undead can overwhelm the night elven homeland.

sections.title: Whispers in the Runes
sections.body: Beyond simply slaying the undead and collecting their dim necrotic stones, scouts are directed to inspect strange, glowing runic formations pulsing on the ground near the invasion encampments. Stepping close to these circles exposes defenders to unsettling supernatural whispers, revealing that the runes serve as unnatural communication relays although Lieutenant Beitha does not know whom the Scourge are contacting.

aliases: who gives investigate the scourge of darnassus
faq.answer: Lieutenant Beitha is an officer representing the Argent Dawn stationed at Darnassus. She organizes local resistance against the Scourge invasion, distributing tasks to curb undead numbers and study their necromantic apparatus.

faq.q: Why is the Scourge attacking Darnassus?
faq.answer: The assignment concerns Scourge forces camped outside Darnassus beneath a necropolis. Lieutenant Beitha asks defenders to thin their numbers and investigate the strange runic circles nearby.

faq.q: What are the glowing runic circles outside the city?
faq.answer: The glowing runic circles appear near the Scourge invasion forces. Lieutenant Beitha asks you to investigate their purpose.
Dim Necrotic Stones are recovered from Scourge invaders and brought to the Argent Dawn as proof of slain undead.

faq.q: Who is funding or leading the response in Darnassus?
faq.answer: The Argent Dawn is coordinating this investigation through Lieutenant Beitha. The order is devoted to opposing the Scourge.

faq.q: Can listening to the runic circles harm you?
faq.answer: Their exact effects are not established. Beitha asks defenders to investigate the strange energy around the circles.

angles.text: For the Kaldorei, the presence of rotting necropolises and defiling undead so close to Teldrassil's holy ground is a grotesque violation that must be purged immediately.
The defense of Darnassus demonstrates the Alliance's commitment to standing united against the global threat posed by the Lich King's invasion force.
Priests face the chilling test of examining corrupted necromantic runes, using their mental discipline and faith to resist the madness whispering through the Scourge's dark network.
The spread of necromancy and decaying flesh on Teldrassil's soil represents an unnatural blight that every protector of the wild is sworn to eradicate.
